### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **30** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**26** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 23d1303d1feff33b22ab3497280c7c601cb5c1b2`.

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **42** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 23d1303d1feff33b22ab3497280c7c601cb5c1b2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c39723309d51799923fec9931cd3dea9cbad836f` — the merge of head `f62e0af4bc52427f86656ef9cb2920f4dc297036` into base `23d1303d1feff33b22ab3497280c7c601cb5c1b2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c39723309d51799923fec9931cd3dea9cbad836f && git checkout c39723309d51799923fec9931cd3dea9cbad836f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 23d1303d1feff33b22ab3497280c7c601cb5c1b2 f62e0af4bc52427f86656ef9cb2920f4dc297036 && git checkout -B drift-repro 23d1303d1feff33b22ab3497280c7c601cb5c1b2 && git merge --no-ff f62e0af4bc52427f86656ef9cb2920f4dc297036

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 23d1303d1feff33b22ab3497280c7c601cb5c1b2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 23d1303d1feff33b22ab3497280c7c601cb5c1b2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `f62e0af4bc52427f86656ef9cb2920f4dc297036`
Local-runs: none

Face: the declaration face alone (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: semantic` in the PR body and the changeset at this head). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28507` reports 0 of 17 paths governed, and no `packages/spec/src/**` path is in the diff, so per `contract-review.md` the record is the lane seat's at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Inputs: card #28409, the os-dev-report 6553114071, the PR body, and the source diff `ea74ebf9..f62e0af4`: `served-override.ts`, `index.ts`, `protocol.ts`, `protocol-environment-rows.ts`, `form-routes.ts` and `packages.ts`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`isServedOverrideRowOf` and `ServedOverrideRow` (new exports from the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` index)**: right. Additive. The predicate is pure and total. It reads the binding from the row's `package_id` through `isCustomizationPairOf` (N-08), never a body stamp. It reads the type folded to its singular through `isOverridableMetadataType`, and the declaration from `overrides.package`. `basedOn` is not judged (ADR-0146 D2). It is the one spelling the card asks for, and N-11, N-15 and N-16 are named as its consumers.
- **`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#getMetaItemsPerPackage` (new public method)**: right. Additive. It is `readFlattenedMetaItems` with `layer: 'per-package'`, which passes neither the override places nor the env-wide narrowing, so it answers the list as it stood at `ea74ebf9`. Runtime types it from the producer's signature as optional. Rest feature-detects it, and a protocol without it is read as before (pinned in `packages-export-per-package-layer.test.ts`).
- **`shippingPackageIds` / `soleShippingPackage`**: not a package-index surface (module exports inside `protocol-environment-rows.ts`). `packagelessContentPackage` now reads its shippers through the first, with the same set.
- **The meaning of the authorable `overrides` key changes (`semantic`)**: right. Before this head no read consulted it (card, "Measured"). Now the pair's declaring item is the document served under X's address. That is the change in what an author's key does, and `semantic` is the right token. It takes `minor` on the three packages the diff moves, which the changeset declares.
- **Write addresses**: unchanged. The override place is passed only by reads that serve X's name. The strict draft read and the view-container package order do not pass `servedOverride`, so a save naming X still writes X's partition. `packagelessAddress` is untouched.
- **No request or response shape moves**: orphans use the existing `overlay` / `effective` fields, and `_packageId` stays a string.

### ② Semver level

- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime` minor**: accepted. A `semantic` kind owes at least `minor` on each package the diff moves (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). The changeset names all three, and `check-changeset-no-major` exits 0 in the dev's gate run.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Ruling on the open question (override beside a package-unbound row)**: the declared override is served. ADR-0146 D8 item 1 keeps the unbound row winning over the code package, and that still holds in the reads and the list. Beside a declared override, `packagelessAddress` sends a package-less save to the pair's row. Serving the unbound row there would answer that save with a read it never changes, which is the #23165 shape. So the dev's choice stands, pinned by `beside a package-unbound row, the declared override is served…`. N-16's migration ends the case.
- **Visible list change, not an accept-set narrowing**: the env-wide list no longer holds a dependent package's same-named item for a name exactly one code package ships. No input is refused and no key is removed. The item stays served under `?package=`, and a name several packages ship is not narrowed. This is the card's Wanted 2 (#28238's list half), so `yes (widening)` is the truthful arm. The PR body's 维护者速读 names the change.
- **Public forms only narrow**: withdrawal is judged against the effective list beside the per-package layer, which is never narrower than the list judged at `ea74ebf9`. The card's ablation (A1) goes red. A form offered only by a body the effective read no longer serves is closed, which is the direction the kill switch allows.
- **The narrowing filter runs on every type except `package`**, including `object`, which is extended and never replaced (D10). The same-name rows it drops are still served under their own address, `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts` keeps its meaning, and the objectql suite is reported green. Recorded so that N-23 (object extension) reads it when it lands, not owed here.
- **Orphan closure**: the layered read reports a dependent's row by `resolveWritePackageScope(owner)?.dependencies.includes(base)`. A row of a package outside X's closure is not reported (A7 goes red).
- **Skills-docs**: `follow-up #28509` (filed by the seat, child of #28236), rewritten in the PR body.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-xhv2az`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QUs3BtyH9zgxKzYrJiH18J`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 已装包（如 HotCRM）的某一项，若其配对 `.custom` 包里有声明 `overrides.package` 指向它的同名项，那么不指定包的读取、`?package=X`、三层视图、按包与全环境列表都返回这份定制；`.custom` 的导出带着定制与声明，基础包导出不变；全环境列表不再让依赖包的同名项挤掉基础包那一项。
- **为什么改：** 之前五个读取口径各说各话，声明了 `overrides` 也没有任何读取用它（ADR-0146 D8，史诗 #28236 的 N-10）。
- **风险与回滚：** 公开表单的撤下判断看「有效列表 + 收窄前的逐包层」，只会更严、不会重新开放；依赖包同名项从全环境列表消失、三层视图展示孤儿项是可见变化。无数据迁移、无接口形状变化，回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts`；`protocol.ts` 的 `servedOverlayRowCandidates` 与 `readFlattenedMetaItems` 末尾的列表收窄；`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts` 的 `resolveFormBySlug`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-custom-override-effective-read.test.ts`（先构建 metadata-protocol），11 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：一个谓词、五个读取一致；写入地址不变；表单只收不放，消融测试证明；可合。

## 席位核对

- **Form:** 17 files, +1415/-60. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28507`: NOT governed, 1475 lines ≤ 3000, Tier S. Declaration of record: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (`isServedOverrideRowOf`, `ServedOverrideRow`, `getMetaItemsPerPackage`) and `Metadata-protocol: semantic` (the `overrides` key now takes effect on the read). TIER_DEFAULT review PASS at this head (6553161378). metadata-protocol, rest and runtime are minor.
- **Premise measured:** the AGREEMENT pin drives five reads of one item over a real protocol and real `ObjectQL`. Packages are installed through the package door, and rows are written through the draft save and per-item publish. The form pin drives `resolveFormBySlug` through the real list, not an injected one.
- **Gates (check-runs at the pinned head):** 52 runs: 37 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending; mergeable, clean. Dev: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. `pnpm lint` 0, typecheck ×4 0, eight ablations went red and each was restored. The card's A1 (withdrawal judged on the narrowed list) goes red.
- **Accepted deviations:** the seat ruled on the dev's open question, override beside a package-unbound row: the override is served, because `packagelessAddress` sends a package-less save to the pair's row (see the review record ③). Four rest harnesses that inject the list now stub the per-package layer as well. The #28238 layered pin now reports the dependent's row as an orphan (the card's Wanted 5). The fold population goes from 17 to 18.
- **Out of scope and where it goes:** the write gate N-09 (#28410), the flow override N-11 (#28412), N-15 (#28411), N-16 (#28413) and N-17/N-19 all stay with their cards. The env-wide narrowing also applies to `object` rows of the same name, recorded for N-23. `Skills-docs: follow-up #28509` (filed by the seat, child of #28236; rewritten in the PR body).
- **Landing clause:** Tier S ordinary queue landing. The seat flips ready and enables auto-merge through the relay, then confirms MERGED and closes out #28409.
